controlled_backlog.criterion: Completion observed within 30 seconds after command return, including daemon startup. The 75-second bound controls eventual observation only.

resources.cpu_boundary: Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN user/system delta immediately before owned spawn to after its known reap in a fresh single-test process; includes any descendants reaped by that worker, which this core fixture does not spawn.
resources.measurement_overhead: No selector-counter hooks. Original INFO plus targeted worker DEBUG and all diagnostic assertions remain enabled; this includes diagnostic overhead and is not pure production-INFO CPU cost or a global CPU/SLO claim.
resources.rss_boundary: Linux ru_maxrss is a child peak high-water value in KiB, not an RSS delta or current RSS; zero prior child high-water and exactly one fixture child are required.
resources.wall_boundary: Monotonic time immediately before spawn through the post-reap resource sample; includes startup, workload polling, replay and graceful shutdown, excluding setup and Cargo build.
